_doc: Demon skins (DemonSkins, scripts/characters/demon_skins.gd). A skin recolors a demon's Blender materials: each material is put in a category by its name (see DemonSkins.CATEGORIES) and its albedo is multiplied by tints[category] ([r, g, b], 1 = unchanged), or replaced by {"color": [r, g, b], "metallic": m, "roughness": r} (a flat new surface keeping only the normal map); every glowing material (eyes, embers, runes) takes `glow` ([r, g, b]) with its energy times `glow_energy`. demons: model ids it fits (empty = every demon). unlock: {} = free; {"stat": "<Progression lifetime stat>", "min": N} (stats: runs, victories, bosses_slain, relics_found, highest_heat); {"unlock": "<Progression unlock id>"} (bought in a shop). hint: shown while locked.

skins.name: True Form
skins.description: As the Pit first made them.

skins.name: Ashen Penitent
skins.description: Burned grey by the long fall. The embers burn white.

skins.name: Soulfire
skins.description: Burns with the stolen light of devoured souls.

skins.name: Bloodsworn
skins.description: Bathed in the blood of the Host and never washed.

skins.name: Voidborn
skins.description: Spat out of the black between the stars.
skins.hint: Finish a run at Heat 3 or higher.

skins.name: Gilded Heretic
skins.description: Wears the gold it tore from fallen archangels.

skins.name: Molten Ravager
skins.description: Mastery of Vharok: plates still glowing from the forge of the Ninth Circle.

skins.name: Choir of Ash
skins.description: Mastery of Lilaeth: her halo has burned to a ring of white cinders.

skins.name: Ink of the Unwritten
skins.description: Mastery of Morvane: every name he unmade is inked across his robes.

skins.name: Gaoler of Storms
skins.description: Mastery of Skarn: his chains hum with captured lightning.

skins.name: Moonless Reaper
skins.description: Mastery of Ysolde: the pale light has gone out of her entirely.

skins.name: Queen of the Hive
skins.description: Mastery of Nhazgul: the combs have turned to black wax and burn with a queen's light.

skins.name: The Unforgiven
skins.description: Mastery of Iscariel: the last of the gold has burned out of his veins and the white wing has finally caught.

skins.name: Archfiend Ascendant
skins.description: Only for a demon whose name Heaven has learned to fear.
skins.hint: Reach mastery X with any demon.
